title: Apple advances health and fitness capabilities using Apple Intelligence
title_zh: 苹果利用Apple Intelligence提升健康与健身功能

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch and iPhone deliver powerful and intelligent health and fitness insights. CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced its most advanced health and fitness experience yet, expanding what Apple Watch and iPhone can do as intelligent, science-driven tools for users’ personal wellbeing. Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 introduce the new Health Sensing System, enabling the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, as well as a new readiness experience to give users insight into their body’s capacity to take on their day. 1 They pair with a redesigned Health app coming later this year to iPhone, which offers a holistic view of long-term health alongside new, easy-to-understand health and longevity insights powered by Apple Intelligence. 2 Together, these updates will give users a more complete picture of their health and fitness while keeping their personal health data private, secure, and under their control. “At Apple, we believe technology can empower everyone with actionable, science-based insights built with privacy at the core. By combining breakthrough sensing on Apple Watch with Apple Intelligence in the Health app, we’re able to translate complex biometric data into clear guidance for users,” said Sumbul Desai, M.D., Apple’s vice president of Health and Fitness. “This both helps people navigate their day-to-day routines with confidence and connects those moments with deeper context around their longevity, building a strong foundation for a healthier future.” The New Health Sensing System on Apple Watch The new Health Sensing System on Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 features new optical and electrical heart sensors, enabling higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, a new readiness score, a more comprehensive Vitals overview with the addition of HRV, and an updated Heart Rate app. Accuracy of health data is critical to providing meaningful insights. A scientifically rigorous study on a population of over 1,000 participants with representation across demographic groups compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, and resulted in Apple Watch showing the highest heart rate accuracy across devices. With larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 now measure heart rate every five seconds, all day long.

paragraphs.en: This continuous, passive measurement delivers deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state while making Exercise and Move Activity rings even more accurate. Users can view their real-time heart rate at a glance throughout their day — whether they’re recovering from a workout or dashing for the train — using the updated Heart Rate app and new watch face complications. A Redesigned Health App with Apple Intelligence at Its Core The Health app on iPhone is a central and secure location for a user’s health and fitness information, and can uniquely provide a better understanding of their overall health. Apple Intelligence brings powerful AI capabilities into the apps and experiences users rely on every day, making them more personal and helpful than ever, and with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, Apple Intelligence extends to the Health app. Redesigned to dynamically adapt to a user’s personal health and fitness metrics, the Health app now offers iPhone and iPad users a view of their long-term health alongside easy-to-understand insights, providing personalized guidance that can help them live a better day and healthier life. The redesigned Health app has been built to securely and privately protect a user’s data at every step. Insights Tab The new Insights tab surfaces timely health information with a summary that updates throughout the day across heart, sleep, readiness, fitness, vitals, and cycle tracking data. A new For You section delivers personalized recommendations and relevant articles based on a user’s data — like a suggestion to improve a wind-down routine after a stretch of late nights. sents.en: Apple Intelligence brings powerful AI capabilities into the apps and experiences users rely on every day, making them more personal and helpful than ever, and with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, Apple Intelligence extends to the Health app.

paragraphs.en: Movement Evaluations Mobility is a critical marker of overall function and a strong predictor of independence, chronic disease risk, and quality of life. Yet routine assessment remains largely absent from proactive health management, typically requiring a visit to an exercise physiologist or physical therapist. Now, users can take in-depth physical assessments — measuring flexibility, strength, balance, movement mechanics, and VO2 max — right at home using their iPhone camera and Apple Watch. This experience runs entirely on device; no video is ever recorded, stored, or shared. Using vision-based AI models, these assessments provide real-time audio and visual feedback, and were developed using clinician input. Users will be able to take in-depth physical assessments — measuring flexibility, strength, balance, movement mechanics, and VO2 max — right at home using their iPhone camera and Apple Watch. Labs Lab results from routine testing can provide important insights into a user’s overall wellbeing. Health app users can already import existing labs and see their results and trends over time. Users will be able to schedule and purchase new labs that feature over 50 key biomarkers for $119 directly through the Health app at approximately 2,000 Quest Diagnostics locations in the U.S. Users will be able to schedule and purchase new labs from Quest directly through the Health app. Tailored Health Content Users will be able to see videos and articles across each area of health that overlays their data with insights from Apple Health clinical experts explaining why it’s important. For example, after a user receives their annual lab results, the Health app will present a video from an expert explaining their LDL levels, what the data means, and how they can take steps to improve, if needed. Or if a user learns from their movement assessment that they need to work on their balance, the Health app will present a video from an expert explaining what they can do. They will also receive an exercise plan to help them improve their balance, with moves selected for their ability and needs. The redesigned Health app will be available later this year, starting in U.S. English, with more languages to follow.

paragraphs.en: Perimenopause and Menopause Support Arrive on Cycle Tracking A person’s menstrual cycle is an essential indicator of overall health, and the Cycle Tracking experience is designed to support individuals across life stages, from logging their first period to receiving a retrospective ovulation estimate, and now, to supporting perimenopause and menopause. Cycle Tracking adapts as users’ health priorities change, whether that’s rooted in curiosity, daily planning, family building, or long-term wellbeing. With iOS 27, the Health app adds support for perimenopause and menopause, as well as notifications about cycle deviations inclusive of perimenopause, to Cycle Tracking. Users will be able to log if they are in perimenopause or menopause for further customization of their Cycle Tracking experience, track their symptoms, and monitor cycles over time. Additionally, if a user logs bleeding after menopause, they will receive a notification to speak with their doctor. New educational articles are available in the Health app to help users better understand this new chapter, in addition to tips informed by clinical experts. Additionally, many people don’t recognize they’re in perimenopause because the symptoms can start years before their last period. Now, users age 40 and over can receive a notification if a deviation in their logged cycle patterns is suggestive of perimenopause, so they can speak to their doctor about it at their next appointment. 4 With iOS 27, the Health app adds support for perimenopause and menopause, as well as notifications about cycle deviations inclusive of perimenopause, in Cycle Tracking. More Ways to Stay Healthy With iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, and watchOS 27, Apple introduces additional ways to stay healthy: Workout Buddy works on Apple Watch even when users don’t have their iPhone nearby. paragraphs.en: Apple advances health and fitness capabilities using Apple Intelligence and the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable

paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced its most advanced health and fitness experience yet, expanding what Apple Watch and iPhone can do as intelligent, science-driven tools for users’ personal wellbeing. Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 introduce the new Health Sensing System, enabling the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, as well as a new readiness experience to give users insight into their body’s capacity to take on their day. 1 They pair with a redesigned Health app coming later this year to iPhone, which offers a holistic view of long-term health alongside new, easy-to-understand health and longevity insights powered by Apple Intelligence. 2 Together, these updates will give users a more complete picture of their health and fitness while keeping their personal health data private, secure, and under their control.

paragraphs.en: The New Health Sensing System on Apple Watch
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch 上的全新健康感知系统

paragraphs.en: The new Health Sensing System on Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 features new optical and electrical heart sensors, enabling higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, a new readiness score, a more comprehensive Vitals overview with the addition of HRV, and an updated Heart Rate app.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 和 Apple Watch Ultra 4 搭载的全新健康传感系统配备了新型光学和电学心脏传感器，支持更高频率的心率与心率变异性（HRV）测量、全新的准备度评分、包含 HRV 的更全面生命体征概览，以及更新后的“心率”应用。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy of health data is critical to providing meaningful insights. A scientifically rigorous study on a population of over 1,000 participants with representation across demographic groups compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, and resulted in Apple Watch showing the highest heart rate accuracy across devices.
paragraphs.zh: 健康数据的准确性对于提供有意义的见解至关重要。 一项针对超过 1000 名参与者（涵盖不同人口统计群体）的严谨科学研究，将 Apple Watch 的新心率感应准确性与主流可穿戴设备进行了比较，结果显示 Apple Watch 在所有设备中展现出最高的心率准确性。

paragraphs.en: With larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 now measure heart rate every five seconds, all day long. This continuous, passive measurement delivers deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state while making Exercise and Move Activity rings even more accurate. Users can view their real-time heart rate at a glance throughout their day — whether they’re recovering from a workout or dashing for the train — using the updated Heart Rate app and new watch face complications.
paragraphs.zh: 光学心率传感器采用了更大且能效更高的绿色 LED，因此 Apple Watch Series 12 和 Apple Watch Ultra 4 现在能够全天每五秒测量一次心率。 这种持续、无感的测量方式能更深入地了解用户的健身状况和生理状态，同时让锻炼与活动环的准确性进一步提升。 借助更新后的“心率”应用和全新的表盘复杂功能，用户无论是在运动后恢复还是赶火车时，都能随时一目了然地查看实时心率。

paragraphs.en: Readiness: A Daily Read on the Body’s Capacity
paragraphs.zh: 准备状态：关于身体能力的每日阅读

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 introduce readiness — a new feature that analyzes a user’s recent activity, vitals, and sleep score, and then provides a single 0-10 score each day with a clear, actionable recommendation: Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready, or Go For It. This helps a user decide how to take on their workday or tackle their training plan.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 和 Apple Watch Ultra 4 推出了“准备就绪”功能——这项新功能会分析用户近期的活动、生命体征和睡眠评分，然后每天给出一个 0-10 分的综合评分，并附带明确且可操作的建议：恢复、控制节奏、准备就绪或全力以赴。 这有助于用户决定如何安排工作日或应对训练计划。

paragraphs.en: A Redesigned Health App with Apple Intelligence at Its Core
paragraphs.zh: 以 Apple Intelligence 为核心的全新健康应用

paragraphs.en: The Health app on iPhone is a central and secure location for a user’s health and fitness information, and can uniquely provide a better understanding of their overall health. Apple Intelligence brings powerful AI capabilities into the apps and experiences users rely on every day, making them more personal and helpful than ever, and with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, Apple Intelligence extends to the Health app. Redesigned to dynamically adapt to a user’s personal health and fitness metrics, the Health app now offers iPhone and iPad users a view of their long-term health alongside easy-to-understand insights, providing personalized guidance that can help them live a better day and healthier life. The redesigned Health app has been built to securely and privately protect a user’s data at every step.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 上的“健康”应用是用户健康与健身信息的集中安全存储地，能够以独特的方式帮助用户更好地了解自身整体健康状况。 Apple Intelligence 将强大的人工智能功能融入用户日常依赖的应用程序和体验中，使其比以往更具个性化和实用性；随着 iOS 27 和 iPadOS 27 的推出，Apple Intelligence 的功能也扩展到了“健康”应用。 “健康”应用经过重新设计，能够动态适应用户的个人健康与健身指标，现在为 iPhone 和 iPad 用户提供了长期健康状况的概览以及易于理解的分析见解，从而提供个性化指导，帮助他们度过更美好的每一天，并拥有更健康的生活。 重新设计的“健康”应用在每个环节都经过构建，以确保用户数据的安全性和隐私性。

paragraphs.en: Insights Tab The new Insights tab surfaces timely health information with a summary that updates throughout the day across heart, sleep, readiness, fitness, vitals, and cycle tracking data. A new For You section delivers personalized recommendations and relevant articles based on a user’s data — like a suggestion to improve a wind-down routine after a stretch of late nights.
paragraphs.zh: 洞察标签页：全新的“洞察”标签页会及时呈现健康信息，其摘要内容会在一天内根据心脏、睡眠、准备状态、健身、生命体征和周期追踪数据持续更新。 全新的“为你推荐”板块会根据用户的数据提供个性化推荐和相关文章——例如，在连续熬夜后，建议用户改善睡前放松流程。

paragraphs.en: Longevity Tab A new Longevity tab analyzes a user’s longitudinal health data for deeper insights into heart health, sleep, mental wellbeing, movement health, metabolic health, hearing, and nutrition. The tab includes Health Age, a new feature that uses Apple Watch data to show users how their metrics are tracking relative to their chronological age, informed by the best available science. The algorithm can factor in metrics from Apple Watch like VO2 max, resting heart rate, sleep, and HRV, and users can also add lab data, including A1c and LDL, to enrich the analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 长寿标签：全新的“长寿”标签会分析用户的纵向健康数据，从而更深入地了解心脏健康、睡眠、心理健康、运动健康、代谢健康、听力和营养状况。 该标签包含“健康年龄”这一新功能，它利用 Apple Watch 的数据，结合当前最可靠的科学研究成果，向用户展示各项指标相对于其实际年龄的变化趋势。 该算法可将 Apple Watch 上的指标（如 VO2 最大值、静息心率、睡眠和 HRV）纳入考量，用户还可以添加实验室数据（包括 A1c 和 LDL），以丰富分析内容。

Users can further build out their health picture through new evaluations, at-home movement assessments, and the ability to add lab tests.
paragraphs.zh: 在“长寿”选项卡中，用户可以根据来自 iPhone、Apple Watch、AirPods 和临床健康记录的数据，以及第三方应用程序和设备的信息，了解影响其长期健康的因素。 一个信息丰富的可视化图表会填充每个类别，帮助用户了解自己在不同健康领域的状况。 用户还可以通过新的评估、居家运动评估以及添加实验室检测功能，进一步构建自己的健康画像。

paragraphs.en: Movement Evaluations Mobility is a critical marker of overall function and a strong predictor of independence, chronic disease risk, and quality of life. Yet routine assessment remains largely absent from proactive health management, typically requiring a visit to an exercise physiologist or physical therapist. Now, users can take in-depth physical assessments — measuring flexibility, strength, balance, movement mechanics, and VO2 max — right at home using their iPhone camera and Apple Watch. This experience runs entirely on device; no video is ever recorded, stored, or shared. Using vision-based AI models, these assessments provide real-time audio and visual feedback, and were developed using clinician input.
paragraphs.zh: 运动评估：活动能力是整体功能的关键指标，也是预测独立性、慢性病风险和生活质量的重要标志。 然而，主动健康管理中仍普遍缺乏常规评估，通常需要前往运动生理学家或物理治疗师的诊所进行。 现在，用户可以直接在家中通过 iPhone 摄像头和 Apple Watch 进行深度身体评估——测量柔韧性、力量、平衡性、运动机制和最大摄氧量（VO2 max）。 整个过程完全在设备本地运行；绝不会记录、存储或共享任何视频。 这些评估基于视觉人工智能模型，可提供实时的音频和视觉反馈，并由临床医生参与开发。

paragraphs.en: Labs Lab results from routine testing can provide important insights into a user’s overall wellbeing. Health app users can already import existing labs and see their results and trends over time. Users will be able to schedule and purchase new labs that feature over 50 key biomarkers for $119 directly through the Health app at approximately 2,000 Quest Diagnostics locations in the U.S.
paragraphs.zh: 常规检测的实验室结果可以为了解用户的整体健康状况提供重要见解。 健康应用的用户已经可以导入现有的实验室数据，并查看其结果及随时间的变化趋势。 用户将能够直接通过健康应用，在美国约 2,000 家 Quest Diagnostics 检测点以 119 美元的价格预约和购买包含超过 50 项关键生物标志物的新检测项目。

paragraphs.en: Tailored Health Content Users will be able to see videos and articles across each area of health that overlays their data with insights from Apple Health clinical experts explaining why it’s important. For example, after a user receives their annual lab results, the Health app will present a video from an expert explaining their LDL levels, what the data means, and how they can take steps to improve, if needed. Or if a user learns from their movement assessment that they need to work on their balance, the Health app will present a video from an expert explaining what they can do. They will also receive an exercise plan to help them improve their balance, with moves selected for their ability and needs.
paragraphs.zh: 定制的健康内容：用户将能够观看涵盖各个健康领域的视频和文章，这些内容会将他们的数据与 Apple Health 临床专家的见解相结合，解释相关事项的重要性。 例如，在用户收到年度实验室检查结果后，健康应用会播放一段专家视频，解释其低密度脂蛋白（LDL）水平、这些数据意味着什么，以及如有需要，他们可以如何采取措施进行改善。 或者，如果用户通过运动评估了解到自己需要改善平衡能力，健康应用会播放一段专家视频，说明他们可以采取哪些行动。 他们还将收到一份锻炼计划以帮助他们改善平衡能力，其中包含根据其能力和需求精选的动作。

paragraphs.en: Perimenopause and Menopause Support Arrive on Cycle Tracking
paragraphs.zh: 围绝经期与绝经期支持功能现已加入周期追踪

paragraphs.en: A person’s menstrual cycle is an essential indicator of overall health, and the Cycle Tracking experience is designed to support individuals across life stages, from logging their first period to receiving a retrospective ovulation estimate, and now, to supporting perimenopause and menopause. Cycle Tracking adapts as users’ health priorities change, whether that’s rooted in curiosity, daily planning, family building, or long-term wellbeing.
paragraphs.zh: 女性的月经周期是整体健康的重要指标，而“周期追踪”功能旨在为不同人生阶段的女性提供支持，从记录首次月经到获得回顾性的排卵期估算，如今更延伸至对围绝经期和绝经期的支持。 “周期追踪”会随着用户健康关注点的变化而调整，无论是出于好奇、日常规划、备孕需求，还是对长期健康的关注。

paragraphs.en: With iOS 27, the Health app adds support for perimenopause and menopause, as well as notifications about cycle deviations inclusive of perimenopause, to Cycle Tracking. Users will be able to log if they are in perimenopause or menopause for further customization of their Cycle Tracking experience, track their symptoms, and monitor cycles over time. Additionally, if a user logs bleeding after menopause, they will receive a notification to speak with their doctor. New educational articles are available in the Health app to help users better understand this new chapter, in addition to tips informed by clinical experts.
